tears down four members of `rcx` in order: `006167C0(rcx+0x568)`; for `rcx+0x218` `0062C100` only when `00625F20` returns non-zero, then `00616D20`; for `rcx+0x188` `0062BF40` only when `00625F10` returns non-zero, then `00616CC0`; for `rcx` itself `0062BCB0` only when `00625F00` returns non-zero, then `00616C60`
